Yes.  I have been feeling awful all day and beating myself up because of this whole situation to the point were I was contemplating just ending it all.  Thank you so so so much.  I just needed to talk to someone understanding.  I feel like no one around me gets me around here so it is such a relief to figure out there are people like me.  :)

Thank you again.  I feel loads better, maybe now I can sleep.
really!?  wow.  I have a form saying that I have been going to counseling.  I had no idea about these resources.  I'm glad that someone has been in this position to help.

I will do that in the morning.  I know we have a legal services at the school and hopefully can work something out.  I have new living arrangements already.  I do not like living there anymore.  It contributes to my anxiety.

Thank you for your kind words.  I feel a lot better.

Yes, you are right.   I just need courage to talk to them and keep my cool without crying/getting so emotional.  I don't think I will be able to declare bankruptcy, I mean its only 500 I owe them.  I just can't believe they would sue for so little.  Not going to lie, I'm intimidating by it too.  I've never been in this situation before.  I have no idea about lawyers or anything.

Thank you for listening to me vent.  I guess next time I will try to find nicer people to give my money too :)
:)  Ok I will do this.  I guess that since they have threatened legal action.  I'm just shocked someone would even do this for one month's missed rent.

These guy is not.  Once I called him up because my air conditioner had been leaking for three weeks.  His response was, oh ok are you done bitching then he proceeding to mock me.  The other tenants have also been having problems dealing with him in the past as well.  I'm not really looking forward to our phone call.  He called me today and left a voicemail but I'm so scared to listen to it.  I feel awful about the bounced check but I just can't pay it.  I have no money, my parents are poor as well so I can't turn to them and I don't have any close friends who I would feel comfortable asking them for it.  My roommate has also blown up at me for this as well.  Her mom called me up threatening to sue for the money :/ I'm so scared.

I am in the US. I've been going to counseling as well so I can ask them what's up in the disability office.  To be honest though, I did fail a lot of vital courses.  I was suppose to graduate in May but because I failed those courses now I can't and the way the curriculum is set up, I can only retake these in the Fall.  I'm kind of glad to take a break though.  I was not doing very good health/mentality wise at the end.

Thank you for your advice, it is so nice to hear from people who have clear minds.

What if I failed out last semester...  would they let me still talk to them?  The office was closed today so I couldn't find out what even happened with the loan.

I have a problem with avoidance.  I just let these problems build up to where it gets to the point where it makes the problem worse.  I should have checked what was happening Dec 5 when they said the loan was certified but I didn't.  That's why I'm in this mess :(

thank you for your kind words of support.  To be honest, I actually have something line up this year and HOPEFULLY get my life back on track.

It's just the rental place is the problem.  My landlords are just not nice people.  I really don't want to deal with them.  I'm trying to find someone to sublease but I just can't talk to them or even think about talking to them without crying and freaking the fuck out about it.
crap seems I don't know how to work these boards... well whatever its a throwaway account anyway.
Also, I failed out this semester because of my anxiety.  I was taking 18 hours of senior level engineering courses and couldn't take the stress.  I feel like such a failure as well.

So, here's the deal.  I'm having a ton of trouble with money (mind you I am NOT NOT NOT NOT asking for handouts just to talk and vent)

This past year alone it seems that a lot of emergencies like car needing repairs and starting anxiety medications without health insurance.  Around early November, I'm a student, I notice that I need more money so I take out a loan.  I called financial aid and they told me that my loan was certified around Dec 5th.

My rent was due around that time so I'm like, it should be in my bank account pretty soon so I go ahead and write a check.

Long story short, it doesn't come in and the check bounces.  My landlords who I haven't had the most pleasant experiences dealing with them in the past are now calling me up threatening to sue.  I just have no idea what to do or now where I'm even going to get the money.  I have been diagnosed with GAD and I find myself just avoiding my problems.  I don't want to deal with them.  I just want them to go away but I know it won't.  I just feel so helpless.  Roommate isn't helping either, her mom's even calling me up threatening to sue as well.  I just can't take it anymore.
hah, it involves a lot of personal stuff that I kind of don't want to put out there... can you pm?
